newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius trade deficit up 26 percent in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius trade deficit up 26 percent in 1996.

text.p: Mauritius external trade deficit rose 26.5 percent to 8.90 billion rupees in 1996 over the previous year, the economic planning ministry said on Wednesday.
The external trade deficit was 7.03 billion rupees in 1995.
Total exports for 1996 were 17 percent higher at 31.99 billion rupees, from 27.32 billion rupees in 1995 and imports rose 19 percent to 40.89 billion rupees, from 34.36 billion rupees in 1995.
"It is to be noted that imports of machinery and transport equipment increased from 6.65 billion rupees in 1995 to 8.91 billion rupees in 1996," the ministry said in a report.

"Proceeds from Export Processing Zone (EPZ) sector, which accounted for 66 percent of total exports during the year 1996, rose by 15 percent over 1995. Exports of sugar, with a share of 25 percent of total exports, increased by 27 percent over 1995," it added. ($1=20.3095 Mauritian rupees)
